result.title: ShellElastic: Scalable Elastic Pretraining with Simultaneous Maximal Updates and Hyperparameter Transfer
result.summary: Foundation models need to support diverse inference budgets, yet training a separate model for each budget duplicates pretraining effort. Elastic models train several nested sub-networks inside one weight-shared supernet, but existing recipes face three obstacles: variable per-step workloads that hinder distributed scaling, limited hyperparameter (HP) transfer across model sizes, and no guarantee that all sub-networks are maximally updated at once. We present \Ours, an elastic transformer that organizes hidden dimensions into a dense core and successive shells, so that every hidden matrix is block lower triangular. One full-width forward pass contains every sub-network's exact hidden states as prefixes, so joint training keeps a fixed computation graph and costs about as much per step as training the widest sub-network alone. We further introduce \muE, an extension of maximal update parameterization (\mup) to \Ours and other elastic architectures. Its scaling rules provably keep all sub-networks of a supernet maximally updated simultaneously (\muI), and keep doing so when the supernet is widened or given more shells; sweeps confirm that HPs tuned on a small non-elastic proxy stay near-optimal for elastic families and larger supernets (\mbox{\muT}). A single \Ours run produces sub-networks that outperform MatFormer and fully elastic baselines at matched parameter counts, and approach separately trained models that together take several times the steps.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ShellElastic 弹性 Transformer，把隐藏维度组织成稠密核心与层层外壳，使一次全宽前向的子网络状态作为前缀同时存在，并用 μE 参数化保证各子网络被同时最大化更新、支持超参从代理模型迁移。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属于预训练效率与权重共享架构、超参迁移范畴，其「弹性」指模型宽度子网络而非推理期计算或隐藏状态，未涉及多模态推理的状态生成、证据获取或停止决策，也无可核查的方法借鉴线索，故排除。
